channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Logo será preciso teste de DNA para separar esquerda e direita
item.description: Difficulty distinguishing left and right by rhetoric; Bolsonarismo supported Lula's 6x1 policy, while Flávio Bolsonaro pushed for the minimum age reduction to block PT's agenda.

item.title: Mendonça encerra processo que tentava impedir ato convocado por Caetano
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça dismissed a lawsuit attempting to block a democracy-themed concert organized by Caetano Veloso in Copacabana. The suit, filed by a state deputy candidate and a non-profit institute, claimed the event was a campaign rally for Lula. Mendonça ruled without examining the merits, citing lack of standing by the plaintiffs, and referred the matter to the Electoral Prosecutor's Office for review.

item.title: A face feminina da direita: quem vota e quem chega ao poder
item.description: Women represent the majority of the Brazilian electorate, accounting for 52.84% of eligible voters in 2026. However, there is significant diversity in political preferences, particularly among those identifying with the right, which has heavily influenced electoral outcomes, as seen in the 2022 and 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo Trump responde a congressistas sem dizer se respeitará resultado da eleição brasileira
item.description: The Trump administration responded to a letter from U.S. congress members regarding U.S. actions in Brazil but did not clarify whether it will respect the outcome of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election.

item.title: Lindbergh: Flávio ligou "modo desespero" ao acionar TSE contra sindicatos
item.description: Lindbergh Farias claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro acted in 'desperation mode' by filing a lawsuit with the TSE against left-wing unions and social organizations, including MST and UNE, accusing him of trying to censor pro-Lula demonstrations. The deputy also criticized Flávio's allegations about pension cuts, as a judge rejected an injunction against the PL candidate.

item.title: Secretário da Saúde de Tarcísio, Eleuses Paiva pede para deixar gestão
item.description: São Paulo Health Secretary Eleuses Paiva requested to leave Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' administration. His departure was expected amid internal criticism, particularly over his son's unsuccessful election campaign. Luiz Carlos Zamarco is cited as a potential successor.

item.title: Na TV, Lula exalta fim da 6x1; Flávio promete Ministério da Prosperidade
item.description: Lula highlighted the approved end of the 6x1 shift in electoral ads as a government achievement. Flávio Bolsonaro, who voted in favor, avoids mentioning it in his campaign and previously opposed the measure. The amendment sets a 40-hour weekly cap without wage cuts.

item.title: Bolsa cai 1% e dólar sobe para R$ 5,087 com pesquisas do 2º turno
item.description: The Brazilian real weakened as the US dollar rose 1,17% to R$ 5,087 and the Ibovespa fell 1,06%, driven by 2-turn election polls and Senate approval of a 6-to-1 work scale. A Quaest poll showed a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Lula (44%), with a 2-point margin of error. Markets await new polls and investor signals on fiscal and inflation risks.

item.title: “Não cederemos à chantagem”, diz líder do Governo sobre maioridade
item.description: Government leader Teresa Leitão (PT-PE) stated the administration will not yield to opposition pressure to include changes to the age of criminal responsibility in the Public Security Constitutional Amendment. The proposal will be voted on without amendments, per a prior agreement. The opposition, led by Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), submitted an amendment to lower the age from 18 to 16, which Leitão branded a delaying tactic.

item.title: Governistas se dividem sobre diminuição da maioridade penal em PEC da Segurança no Senado
item.description: Government party members in the Senate are divided over including the reduction of the criminal age to 16 for heinous crimes in the Public Security PEC. Camilo Santana, a Lula ally, supports the measure to counter an opposition proposal lowering it to 14, while some PT members prefer further debate. The deadlock may delay the PEC vote, which aims to create the Ministry of Public Security.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza de olho em aprovação do fim da escala 6×1 e disputa eleitoral acirrada
item.description: The Ibovespa dropped 1.06% to 204,300 points, pressured by the approval of the 6x1 schedule and electoral uncertainty, with construction stocks leading losses and education and health stocks helping to cushion the decline. The market reacts to fears of a possible defeat of Flávio Bolsonaro, seen as a favorite for defending an orthodox fiscal policy, while the dollar rises to R$ 5.09.

item.title: CNBB diz que reduzir maioridade penal 'não enfrenta causas da violência nem oferece respostas duradouras'
item.description: The CNBB reaffirms its historical stance against lowering the age of criminal responsibility, arguing that such measures do not address violence and provide no lasting solutions. Amid the Public Security constitutional amendment debate, opposition parties propose amendments to lower the criminal age, but the CNBB advocates for investment in youth protection, education, and promotion instead of early imprisonment.

item.title: "Eleição de Lula vai afetar o Fundo Constitucional do DF", afirma Hermeto
item.description: District deputy Hermeto (MDB) claims a Lula victory in 2026 could lead to the federalization of Banco de Brasília and the dismantling of the DF Constitutional Fund, affecting health, education, and security. He criticizes the approval of the end of the 6×1 scale as an electoral maneuver and warns about potential changes in the STF.

item.title: Brazil Journal, IstoÉ e portais de esquerda; como Vorcaro montou rede de influência em sites de notícias
item.description: Federal Police messages reveal that Daniel Vorcaro, former banker, used sponsorships and investments from companies linked to him to build an influence network in news sites such as Brasil Journal, IstoÉ, and left-wing portals. The strategy aimed to shape media narratives and expand his political and economic influence. The case illustrates how public figures can use non-traditional communication channels for image manipulation and propaganda.

item.title: TSE decide pela remoção de vídeos que associam Lula a supostas fraudes no INSS
item.description: The TSE plenary decided to remove videos linking Lula to alleged INSS frauds involving his son, preserving only speech protected by free expression. The coalition Brasil Pronto Pra Mais requested removal against Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira, with a 24-hour deadline for action.

item.title: Meta se reúne com Nunes Marques após IA bloquear cartaz de Lula com número 13
item.description: Meta representatives met with TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques to discuss unequal treatment of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro campaign content by AI filters on WhatsApp. The platform's AI blocked Lula campaign posters with number 13 but approved Flávio Bolsonaro and Augusto Cury materials, sparking electoral controversy. Meta stated it has been refining its algorithms since Tuesday the 13th, following TSE guidelines.

item.title: Eleições: O que Holanda e Austrália podem nos ensinar sobre avaliar promessas de campanha
item.description: The text highlights the lack of substantive debates in the election and suggests that experiences from countries like the Netherlands and Australia can inspire more policy-focused Brazilian elections. It proposes adopting practices that encourage the evaluation of campaign promises.

item.title: Renan Santos vê ‘perigo de acúmulo de poder’ maior com eventual vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Renan Santos, defeated candidate from Missão in the first round, stated he sees a greater risk of power concentration with a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) victory than with Lula's (PT) reelection, but does not anticipate a military coup with the PL candidate. He released his supporters to vote in the second round and did not reveal a preference between the two candidates.

item.title: Nikolas monta maratona de atos de rua para ajudar a campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) announced a street rally marathon to boost support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign. The event, called 'Nikolas' bloquinho,' will take place in several Brazilian cities from October 15 to 24, ending with a motorcycle parade in Belo Horizonte and events in Rio de Janeiro. Nikolas, elected with 3.1 million votes, aims to replicate his successful campaign strategy to strengthen Flávio's race against Lula in the runoff.

item.title: Justiça manda PF investigar Ana Elisa, deputada eleita do PT, por suposta fake news contra Flávio
item.description: The Electoral Court of Divinópolis ordered the Federal Police to investigate elected deputy Ana Elisa (PT-MG) for alleged fake news against Flávio Bolsonaro, following a criminal complaint filed by the senator. Posts on X would have claimed that Flávio proposed removing the title of patron saint of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida. Judge Orlando Israel rejected preventive detention but ordered X to preserve the posts and opened an investigation to verify the allegations.

item.title: Partido de Flávio votou a favor do fim da 6×1 por ‘medo’ do eleitor, diz Alckmin
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that PL lawmakers supported ending the 6×1 work schedule out of electoral fear and may reverse it if Flávio Bolsonaro is elected. He advocated fiscal adjustment but rejected cutting retirees, favoring action against high salaries and privileges.

item.title: Flávio é aconselhado a falar mais sobre Moraes e Lulinha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has been advised by allies to resume direct criticism of figures like Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Fábio Lula da Silva to keep his base mobilized and prevent falling behind the PT's Lula. Allies are concerned about complacency after first-round success, with the campaign mostly responding to attacks and using anti-PT rhetoric. Flávio is also trying to avoid Supreme Court interference in the second round.

item.title: Mídia internacional destaca vitória de Lula com o fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: The Brazilian Senate approved Constitution Amendment Bill 221/2019, reducing the weekly workday from 44 to 40 hours with two paid rest days and no salary cut. The move was highlighted by international media as a political victory for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ahead of the 2026 presidential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula celebrated the approval on social media, linking it to improved quality of life for workers.

item.title: Sindicato levará relatos de assédio eleitoral de reitor à Justiça
item.description: The São Paulo Teachers Union (SinproSP) filed charges of electoral harassment against the rector of Centro Universitário Belas Artes, Paulo Cardim, for emails criticizing President Lula and the federal government. The rector did not attend the meeting scheduled by the union to provide clarifications. The complaints will be forwarded to the Labor Public Ministry, the Electoral Public Ministry, and the Superior Electoral Court.

item.title: Redução da maioridade penal entra na discussão da PEC da Segurança; Brasil já previu punição de crianças a partir dos 7 anos
item.description: The Public Security PEC will be voted on in the Senate, with the opposition attempting to include the reduction of the criminal majority age. The amendment by Rogério Marinho and Flávio Bolsonaro proposes setting the age of majority at 16 years for common crimes and 14 for heinous crimes. The debate coincides with the electoral period and has a historical background dating back to the colonial period, when criminal responsibility began at 7 years old.

item.title: TSE confirma ordem de Mendonça para que governo Lula informe gastos com publicidade
item.description: The TSE confirmed a ruling by Minister André Mendonça ordering the Lula government to report public advertising expenditures between 2023 and 2026, in a lawsuit filed by the PL party. The hearing was moved to the physical plenary after a motion by Minister Floriano, who raised concerns over the broad scope of requested data. The PL accuses the government of significantly increasing public advertising expenses beyond electoral limits, including digital campaigns and program promotions.

item.title: No horário eleitoral, Lula questiona posição de Flávio sobre fim da escala 6x1; candidato do PL aborda Ministério da Prosperidade
item.description: During the election period, Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for changing his position on the end of the 6x1 scale, promising to repeal the measure if elected. Flávio, on the other hand, presented the Ministry of Prosperity and 'ViraPix', initiatives not included in his official government plan registered with the electoral court.

item.title: TSE se reúne com Meta para tratar de IA que bloqueia imagem de Lula
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court met with Meta to discuss the controversy surrounding the WhatsApp AI, which blocks campaign images of President Lula but allows those of Flávio Bolsonaro. The alliance Brasil Pronto Pra Mais labeled the behavior as manipulation of public debate and requested urgent measures from the TSE.

item.title: Flávio visita Jair Bolsonaro em Brasília pela segunda vez após fim da proibição de Moraes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in Brasília for the second time after the Supreme Court lifted a 90-day ban. The meeting took place on Thursday, 15th, under conditions set by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, prohibiting political statements. Jair Bolsonaro has been under house arrest since March for attempted coup d'état.

item.title: Senador Viana pede ao STF dados sobre voos de Vorcaro que estão em sigilo
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) requested information from the STF regarding the flights of banker Daniel Vorcaro's jet, after the Brazilian Air Force imposed a 100-year secrecy order on the flight plan and passenger list. The request follows Vorcaro's arrest in Guarulhos for billion-dollar fraud. Viana criticized the secrecy and pledged that the data will be disclosed.

item.title: TSE usurpador
item.description: The column sharply criticizes the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) for annulling over 200,000 votes in the Rio de Janeiro state elections, alleging a violation of the constitutional clause protecting the secret ballot and popular sovereignty. The author questions TSE's legitimacy and portrays the judiciary as mired in corruption and partisanship.

item.title: Flávio tem 51%, e Lula, 49% no 2º turno, mostra Indexa/Broadcast
item.description: A survey by Indexa/Broadcast released on October 15, 2026, shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round of the presidential election, with 51% and 49% of valid votes, respectively. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points, based on interviews with 2,000 people.

item.title: Alckmin, Marina e Tebet lideram ato em São Paulo em apoio a Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Political leaders and civil society representatives gather in São Paulo to support Lula's reelection in the runoff, launching a manifesto defending democracy, institutional stability, and social justice. Alckmin, Marina, and Tebet lead the event, aiming to unite diverse sectors against Flávio Bolsonaro's rise.

item.title: Quem é Márcio Canella, 2º deputado estadual mais votado do RJ que foi preso pela PF
item.description: Márcio Canella, the second-most-voted state congressman in Rio de Janeiro, was arrested in the 8th phase of 'Operação Unha e Carne' for illegal firearm possession. He had previously been detained in July after being caught with an assault rifle, but was released under electronic monitoring by the Supreme Court.

item.title: Ao vivo: Senado vota PEC da Segurança Pública
item.description: The Senate began voting on the Public Security PEC, which integrates police forces, strengthens the prison system, and increases funding transfers to states. The measure requires 49 votes in two rounds to proceed and does not create the Ministry of Public Security, though President Lula said he intends to establish it after its approval.

item.title: PGE pede apuração de 255 perfis suspeitos de promover Flávio e atacar Lula
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office requested that the TSE compel Meta to investigate 255 suspicious profiles promoting Flávio Bolsonaro and attacking Lula through AI-generated content. The study by Instituto Democracia em Xeque identified 1,204 publications with 58 million views in one month. Meta claimed to have analyzed only 35 profiles, which was deemed insufficient by the prosecution.

item.title: Fim da 6x1 terá mudanças pós-eleição para excluir setores; texto já é preparado por base de Lula
item.description: Lula's base is preparing a new constitutional amendment to exempt certain sectors from the end of the 6x1 work schedule, with changes to be implemented after the election. The text aims to adjust legislation to avoid impacts on specific sectors such as offshore oil platform workers and pilots, maintaining 40 weekly hours and two weekly rest days.

item.title: O dado da Quaest que colocou a campanha de Lula em alerta
item.description: A Quaest survey revealed that 10% of Flávio Bolsonaro voters decided on election day, compared to just 5% of Lula's supporters. This put the president's campaign on alert, emphasizing the need to maintain momentum in the runoff until the final day. The pro-Lula base intensified social media and street mobilizations to secure re-election.

item.title: Pellegrino critica forma como PL a citou em ação: “É violência de gênero”
item.description: Antonia Pellegrino, president of EBC, accused the PL of committing political gender violence by mentioning her in a criminal news report related to an audio failure in Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral advertisement. She criticized how her identity was portrayed by the media, noting she was referred to as 'wife of' instead of being recognized for her career. She notified false publications and threatened legal action.

item.title: Crusoé: Ex-presidentes ibero-americanos manifestam apoio a Flávio
item.description: Former Ibero-American presidents from the Libertad y Democracia group expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy in Brazil. The statement includes figures like Iván Duque, Mario Abdo Benítez, and Mauricio Macri, highlighting international alliances in the campaign.

item.title: Una asociación de descendientes de españoles se persona en el Supremo contra la suspensión del voto de los nacionalizados por la ‘ley de nietos’
item.description: An Argentine association of Spanish descendants filed a lawsuit before the Supreme Court against the suspension of voting rights for naturalized citizens under the 'grandchildren law'. The Supreme Court suspended the voting rights of over 163,000 Spanish citizens residing abroad who obtained nationality through lineage.

item.title: MP defendeu barrar candidatura de Canella, aliado de Flávio Bolsonaro, por suspeita de ligação com milícias
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry recommended rejecting Márcio Canella’s candidacy, former mayor of Belford Roxo, due to suspected ties with militias, after a rifle was seized from his car and investigations into money laundering and organized crime. Despite the recommendation, the Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court authorized his campaign for the state assembly, where he became the second-highest vote-getter.

item.title: PF investiga elo de esquema que beneficiou Canella com empresas ligadas ao PCC
item.description: The Federal Police launched the eighth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, investigating a R$7.6 billion money laundering scheme through a network of gas stations in Rio de Janeiro. Former mayor of Belford Roxo and elected state deputy Márcio Canella (União Brasil) is identified as a beneficiary and the main political organizer of the criminal group.

item.title: Estela Aranha nega remover vídeo de Carlos Bolsonaro contra Lula
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha rejected Lula campaign's request to remove Carlos Bolsonaro video about wage adjustments. The post was based on a Valor Econômico newspaper report. The ruling was preliminary, with full review pending.

item.title: Wolney Queiroz vê virada de Lula nas pesquisas na próxima semana
item.description: The Minister of Social Security, Wolney Queiroz, stated that Lula's lead over Flávio Bolsonaro is already underway and should appear in polls from October 20th. He highlighted the popular pro-Lula mobilization, comparing it to the 1992 student movements, and criticized the risk of a Flávio Bolsonaro government.

item.title: Kassio e Mendonça se reúnem com Meta após polêmicas sobre canais e IA que favorece Flávio
item.description: TSE ministers Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça met with Meta representatives to discuss controversies involving communication channels and AI usage that may have favored presidential candidate Flávio Dino. The meeting takes place amid growing debates about the role of social media in the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Como votaram em Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula as cidades mais e menos eficientes do Brasil; confira a sua
item.description: The article introduces an interactive tool that correlates the 2026 municipal election results with the Folha Efficiency Ranking of Municipalities, showing how the most and least efficient cities voted. The analysis cross-references votes for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro with performance indicators such as fiscal management, transparency, and public service quality.

item.title: Ministério da Prosperidade proposto por Flávio Bolsonaro tem apelo evangélico e coaching
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) proposed creating the Ministry of Prosperity, positioning himself as more ambitious than Bolsa Família. The proposal, made after the first round of elections, aims to attract evangelical support and use personal coaching rhetoric.

item.title: Dólar abre em alta com empate entre Flávio e Lula e aprovação da escala 6x1 no radar
item.description: The dollar opened higher at R$5.053, reflecting a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the latest Quaest poll, with 46% and 44% vote intentions, respectively. The 6x1 scale was also approved on the radar, impacting the economy.

item.title: Na pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast, 50% desaprovam forma de administrar de Lula; 45% a aprovam
item.description: Indexa/Broadcast poll shows 50% of voters disapprove of Lula's administration, while 45% approve and 5% do not express an opinion. The survey, released on Thursday (15), reflects significant division in public opinion regarding the incumbent president running for re-election.
